zh.name: 帽
zh.rule: 深綠色軟帽，連童軍（金屬）帽章：帽章戴喺軟帽黑色膠邊左眼上方約 2 釐米。軟帽戴喺眉毛上約 2 釐米，向右邊拉低。宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: Beret
en.rule: Dark green beret with the (metal) Scout cap badge, worn on the black band about 2 cm above the left eye. The beret sits about 2 cm above the eyebrows, pulled down to the right. Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 帽章圖案取自手冊 P.102 相片（細圖放大，會有啲矇）。方塊人嘅軟帽只係示意形狀。
modelNote.en: The cap badge artwork is from the Handbook p.102 photo (a small image enlarged, so slightly blurry). The blocky beret is only an indicative shape.

zh.name: 恤衫
zh.rule: 杏色、短袖、兩胸袋、無褶、肩帶。

en.name: Shirt
en.rule: Beige, short sleeves, two chest pockets, no pleats, shoulder straps.

zh.name: 短褲／裙褲
zh.rule: 男團員：草青色短褲，兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶。女團員：草青色裙褲，側袋、弓字褶。

en.name: Shorts / culottes
en.rule: Boys: grass-green shorts, two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated. Girls: grass-green culottes, side pockets, box pleat.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.26：旅長可決定全旅喺冬季改穿長褲；模型只畫短褲／裙褲。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.26: the Group Scout Leader may switch the whole Group to long trousers in winter; the model shows shorts/culottes only.

en.name: Belt
en.rule: Brown, with the Scout badge buckle.

modelNote.zh: 皮帶扣只畫銀色方塊示意，冇畫徽號。
modelNote.en: The buckle is a plain silver block; the emblem is not drawn.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.31 同綱要 P.12 附圖：襪頭摺下；模型照畫。
modelNote.en: The Handbook p.31 and Training Scheme p.12 figures show turned-down tops; the model follows them.

zh.name: 領巾
zh.rule: 旅巾（連童軍巾圈，即皮巾圈）；可改戴小隊活動巾圈。宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: Neckerchief
en.rule: Group neckerchief with the Scout (leather) woggle; a patrol activity woggle may be worn instead. Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 旅巾顏色由各旅自定，模型可自選；巾圈畫做啡色皮巾圈（手冊 P.110 相片），冇畫徽號。
modelNote.en: Neckerchief colours are set by each Group; pick them in the model. The woggle is drawn as a brown leather woggle (Handbook p.110 photo) without the emblem.

zh.name: 制服毛衣（可選）
zh.rule: 可因應個人體質或天氣情況穿著深草青色制服毛衣。領巾放喺毛衣外面；毛衣上只可以喺適當位置戴世界童軍會員章、香港章同旅章，其他章唔可以戴喺毛衣上。

en.name: Uniform jersey (optional)
en.rule: A dark grass-green uniform jersey may be worn for personal comfort or the weather. The neckerchief goes outside the jersey; only the World Membership Badge, Hong Kong Badge and Group Badge may be worn on it, in the appropriate places; no other badges.

modelNote.zh: 毛衣畫做長袖、坑紋、圓領（見到恤衫領）、膊頭淺色膊布（手冊 P.121–122 附圖）。徽章「或制服毛衣相同位置」：位置同恤衫一樣，向外移一個毛衣厚度。
modelNote.en: The jersey is drawn long-sleeved and ribbed, with a crew neck (shirt collar showing) and lighter shoulder patches (Handbook pp.121–122 figures). Badges go in “the same position on the uniform jersey”: the shirt positions, moved out by the jersey thickness.

zh.name: 童軍
zh.note: 陸上童軍（手冊 P.30–31；綱要 P.12）。

en.name: Scouts
en.note: Land Scouts (Handbook pp.30–31; Training Scheme p.12).

zh.name: 海童軍
zh.note: 海童軍（手冊 P.32–33；綱要 P.13）：徽章同擺位同童軍一樣（世界童軍會員章、香港章、地域章、區章、旅章、小隊章）；帽、恤衫、褲、襪唔同。

en.name: Sea Scouts
en.note: Sea Scouts (Handbook pp.32–33; Training Scheme p.13): the same badges in the same places as Scouts (World Membership, Hong Kong, Region, District, Group and Patrol Badges); the cap, shirt, shorts and socks differ.

zh.name: 帽
zh.rule: 海童軍白頂帽（連海童軍帽帶）：帽邊喺眼眉上方約 2 釐米，整頂帽邊同水平線看齊。帽帶戴喺白頂帽白色帽邊下方，繡有「SEA SCOUTS」字眼嘅部份放喺帽前中央；喺帽子左邊中央位置將帽帶尾綁上蝴蝶結，蝴蝶結及裁剪後嘅帽帶尾各長 3 釐米。宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: Cap
en.rule: Sea Scout white-top cap with the Sea Scout cap tally: the brim sits about 2 cm above the eyebrows and level. The tally is worn below the white edge of the cap with the “SEA SCOUTS” lettering at the front centre; its ends are tied in a bow at the middle of the left side, the bow and the trimmed tails each 3 cm long. Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 帽帶圖案取自手冊 P.102 相片（細圖放大）。方塊人嘅白頂帽只係示意形狀；蝴蝶結畫喺穿著者左邊（+x）。
modelNote.en: The tally artwork is from the Handbook p.102 photo (a small image enlarged). The blocky white-top cap is only an indicative shape; the bow is on the wearer's left (+x).

zh.name: 恤衫
zh.rule: 白色、短袖、兩胸袋、無褶、肩帶。

en.name: Shirt
en.rule: White, short sleeves, two chest pockets, no pleats, shoulder straps.

zh.name: 短褲／裙褲
zh.rule: 男團員：深藍色短褲，兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶。女團員：深藍色裙褲，側袋、弓字褶。

en.name: Shorts / culottes
en.rule: Boys: dark blue shorts, two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated. Girls: dark blue culottes, side pockets, box pleat.

zh.name: 制服毛衣（可選）
zh.rule: 可因應個人體質或天氣情況穿著深藍色制服毛衣。領巾放喺毛衣外面；毛衣上只可以喺適當位置戴世界童軍會員章、香港章同旅章，其他章唔可以戴喺毛衣上。

en.name: Uniform jersey (optional)
en.rule: A dark blue uniform jersey may be worn for personal comfort or the weather. The neckerchief goes outside the jersey; only the World Membership Badge, Hong Kong Badge and Group Badge may be worn on it, in the appropriate places; no other badges.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.121：海童軍／空童軍青少年成員穿深藍色制服毛衣。毛衣畫做長袖、坑紋、圓領（見到恤衫領）、膊頭淺色膊布（手冊 P.121–122 附圖）。徽章「或制服毛衣相同位置」：位置同恤衫一樣，向外移一個毛衣厚度。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.121: Sea/Air Scout youth members wear the dark blue jersey. The jersey is drawn long-sleeved and ribbed, with a crew neck (shirt collar showing) and lighter shoulder patches (Handbook pp.121–122 figures). Badges go in “the same position on the uniform jersey”: the shirt positions, moved out by the jersey thickness.

zh.name: 空童軍
zh.note: 空童軍（手冊 P.34–35；綱要 P.14）：徽章同擺位同童軍一樣（世界童軍會員章、香港章、地域章、區章、旅章、小隊章）；帽、恤衫、褲、襪唔同。

en.name: Air Scouts
en.note: Air Scouts (Handbook pp.34–35; Training Scheme p.14): the same badges in the same places as Scouts (World Membership, Hong Kong, Region, District, Group and Patrol Badges); the beret, shirt, shorts and socks differ.

zh.name: 帽
zh.rule: 灰藍色軟帽，連童軍（金屬）帽章：帽章戴喺軟帽黑色膠邊左眼上方約 2 釐米。軟帽戴喺眉毛上約 2 釐米，向右邊拉低。宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: Beret
en.rule: Grey-blue beret with the (metal) Scout cap badge, worn on the black band about 2 cm above the left eye. The beret sits about 2 cm above the eyebrows, pulled down to the right. Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 帽章同童軍一樣（手冊 P.102「童軍、空童軍…佩戴」）。顏色跟綱要 P.14 附圖（深灰藍）；方塊人嘅軟帽只係示意形狀。
modelNote.en: Same cap badge as Scouts (Handbook p.102 “worn by Scouts, Air Scouts…”). The colour follows the Training Scheme p.14 figure (dark grey-blue); the blocky beret is only an indicative shape.

zh.name: 恤衫
zh.rule: 淺藍色、短袖、兩胸袋、無褶、肩帶。

en.name: Shirt
en.rule: Light blue, short sleeves, two chest pockets, no pleats, shoulder straps.

zh.name: 短褲／裙褲
zh.rule: 男團員：深藍色短褲，兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶。女團員：深藍色裙褲，側袋、弓字褶。

en.name: Shorts / culottes
en.rule: Boys: dark blue shorts, two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated. Girls: dark blue culottes, side pockets, box pleat.

zh.rule: 可因應個人體質或天氣情況穿著深藍色制服毛衣。領巾放喺毛衣外面；毛衣上只可以喺適當位置戴世界童軍會員章、香港章同旅章，其他章唔可以戴喺毛衣上。

en.name: Uniform jersey (optional)
en.rule: A dark blue uniform jersey may be worn for personal comfort or the weather. The neckerchief goes outside the jersey; only the World Membership Badge, Hong Kong Badge and Group Badge may be worn on it, in the appropriate places; no other badges.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.121：海童軍／空童軍青少年成員穿深藍色制服毛衣。毛衣畫做長袖、坑紋、圓領（見到恤衫領）、膊頭淺色膊布（手冊 P.121–122 附圖）。徽章「或制服毛衣相同位置」：位置同恤衫一樣，向外移一個毛衣厚度。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.121: Sea/Air Scout youth members wear the dark blue jersey. The jersey is drawn long-sleeved and ribbed, with a crew neck (shirt collar showing) and lighter shoulder patches (Handbook pp.121–122 figures). Badges go in “the same position on the uniform jersey”: the shirt positions, moved out by the jersey thickness.

zh.name: 世界童軍會員章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋中央。
zh.quote: 童軍成員佩戴在制服恤衫……左胸袋中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。童軍成員宣誓後纔可佩戴。
zh.conditions: 宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: World Membership Badge
en.place: Centre of the wearer's left chest pocket.
en.quote: Worn centred on the left chest pocket of the uniform shirt, or the same position on the uniform sweater. Worn only after investiture.
en.conditions: Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用直徑 4 cm，按 P.169 附圖同胸袋嘅比例。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 cm diameter, from its proportion to the pocket in the p.169 figure.

zh.name: 香港章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方 3 釐米，置中。
zh.quote: 幼童軍、童軍及深資童軍佩戴在制服恤衫左胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章。

en.name: Hong Kong Badge
en.place: Centred 3 cm above the flap of the wearer's left chest pocket.
en.quote: Cub Scouts, Scouts and Venture Scouts wear it centred 3 cm above the left chest pocket flap of the uniform shirt, or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Basic badge.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 4 × 5.6 cm（跟 P.93 圖案比例）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 × 5.6 cm (the p.93 artwork's proportions).

zh.name: 旅章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，肩膊縫線下方 2 釐米，置中。
zh.quote: 旅成員佩戴在制服恤衫……右袖肩膊位下方二釐米中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；由所屬旅提供。

en.name: Group Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred 2 cm below the shoulder seam.
en.quote: Group members wear it centred 2 cm below the shoulder on the right sleeve of the uniform shirt, or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Basic badge; supplied by the Group.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.94：新成立旅嘅旅章不小過 8.5 × 2 cm、不大過 10.5 × 2.5 cm；模型用 9 × 2.2 cm。圖案係手冊示例（2222 旅），各旅實際圖案唔同。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.94: a new Group's badge is between 8.5 × 2 cm and 10.5 × 2.5 cm; the model uses 9 × 2.2 cm. The artwork is the handbook example (2222th Group); each Group's badge differs.

zh.name: 地域章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，旅章下方 2 釐米；地域章在前（靠穿著者前面），區章在後，兩章相距 1 釐米。
zh.quote: 區幹部……及旅成員同時佩戴所屬地域章及區章在制服恤衫右袖香港肩章／旅章下方二釐米中央位置；地域章在前，區章在後，兩章相距一釐米。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；跟所屬區嘅地域。

en.name: Region Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, 2 cm below the Group Badge; Region Badge in front (toward the wearer's front), District Badge behind, 1 cm apart.
en.quote: Group members wear both the Region and District Badges centred 2 cm below the Group Badge on the right sleeve; Region Badge in front, District Badge behind, 1 cm apart.
en.conditions: Basic badge; the Region of the member's District.

modelNote.zh: 圖案跟「區章」揀咗嘅區自動轉做所屬地域；未揀區就用手冊 P.168 示例色塊。總會總部屬下嘅區（例如銀禧區）網頁冇列地域章，模型唔顯示。手冊 P.169 同綱要 P.12 附圖都係前面（望住右袖時右手邊）地域章、後面區章，同 P.95 文字一致。只得一個（例如總會總部屬下嘅銀禧區冇地域章，或者熄咗其中一個）就放喺旅章下面中間（用戶指示）。
modelNote.en: The artwork follows the Region of the District picked under District Badge; with no District picked it uses the Handbook p.168 example block. Districts under AHQ (e.g. Silver Jubilee) have no Region Badge on the web page, so none is shown. The Handbook p.169 and Training Scheme p.12 figures both put the Region Badge in front (right-hand side when looking at the right sleeve) and the District Badge behind, matching the p.95 text. When only one of the pair is worn (e.g. Silver Jubilee District under AHQ has no Region Badge, or one is switched off) it goes centred below the Group Badge (user instruction).

zh.name: 區章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，旅章下方 2 釐米；喺地域章後面，相距 1 釐米。
zh.quote: 地域章在前，區章在後，兩章相距一釐米。地域章及區章……尺寸是 3.8 釐米（闊）× 5 釐米（高）。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；揀返自己所屬嘅區。

en.name: District Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, 2 cm below the Group Badge; behind the Region Badge, 1 cm apart.
en.quote: Region Badge in front, District Badge behind, 1 cm apart. Region and District Badges are 3.8 cm wide × 5 cm high.
en.conditions: Basic badge; pick your own District.

modelNote.zh: 可以揀全港所有區（香港童軍總會網頁「地域及區」）；未揀區就用手冊示例色塊。只得一個（例如總會總部屬下嘅銀禧區冇地域章，或者熄咗其中一個）就放喺旅章下面中間（用戶指示）。
modelNote.en: Every District can be picked (SAHK “Regions and Districts” page); with none picked it uses the handbook example block. When only one of the pair is worn (e.g. Silver Jubilee District under AHQ has no Region Badge, or one is switched off) it goes centred below the Group Badge (user instruction).

zh.name: 童軍小隊章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，袖口縫線上方 3 釐米，置中。
zh.quote: 童軍佩戴所屬小隊章在制服恤衫右袖縫線上方三釐米中央位置。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；揀返自己所屬小隊（32 隊）。團隊長不佩戴；宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: Scout Patrol Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred 3 cm above the sleeve seam.
en.quote: Scouts wear their Patrol Badge centred 3 cm above the right sleeve seam of the uniform shirt.
en.conditions: Basic badge; pick your own patrol (32 patrols). Not worn by the Troop Leader; worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 4 × 1.6 cm（綱要 P.200–202 圖案比例；手冊 P.131、P.169 同綱要 P.12 附圖對比旅章約闊 3.6–5.1 cm）。圖案係綱要 P.200–202 嘅官方小隊章（左右兩格隊色），未揀小隊就用 P.200 第一個（獾，紫白）做示例。隊色方向（用戶確認）：以人望住小隊章嘅面向，圖案左邊嗰格近背、右邊嗰格近胸（例：獾 左紫近背、右白近胸）；模型照呢個方向貼。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 × 1.6 cm (the proportions of the Training Scheme pp.200–202 artwork; against the Group Badge, the Handbook pp.131, 169 and Training Scheme p.12 figures give about 3.6–5.1 cm wide). The artwork is the official patrol badge from Training Scheme pp.200–202 (two colour blocks); with no patrol picked it shows the first one on p.200 (Badger, purple and white) as an example. Colour direction (confirmed by the user): as seen by a person looking at the badge, the left block is toward the back and the right block toward the chest (e.g. Badger: purple toward the back, white toward the chest); the model follows this.

zh.name: 優異旅團章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，袖口縫線上方中央，為期一年。
zh.quote: 佩戴在制服恤衫右袖縫線上方中央位置，為期一年。有紅、紫和粉藍等三種顏色，每年輪流使用。
zh.conditions: 「優異旅團獎勵計劃」獲獎旅團嘅領袖、教練員及團員；為期一年。

en.name: Meritorious Group Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred above the sleeve-hem seam, for one year.
en.quote: Worn centred above the right sleeve seam of the uniform shirt, for one year. Comes in red, purple and light blue, used in turn each year.
en.conditions: Leaders, instructors and members of a Group awarded under the Meritorious Group Scheme; for one year.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 9 × 2 cm（P.159 圖案比例）。可以輸入年份：圖案底色同文字取自 P.159，只換年份數字；顏色每 3 年輪一次（1999 紅、2000 紫、2001 藍……，P.159 2016 藍、2017 紅、2018 紫吻合）。 手冊 P.169 同綱要 P.12 附圖：童軍嘅優異旅團章喺小隊章下面、貼近袖口縫線。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 9 × 2 cm (p.159 artwork proportions). Type a year: the background and lettering come from p.159 and only the year digits change; the colour cycles every 3 years (1999 red, 2000 purple, 2001 blue…, matching 2016 blue, 2017 red, 2018 purple on p.159). The Handbook p.169 and Training Scheme p.12 figures put the Scout Meritorious Group Badge below the Patrol Badge, just above the sleeve seam.

zh.name: 模範童軍肩帶（雞繩）
zh.place: 掛喺右肩肩帶下面，兜過膊頭沿袖窿前面落去，末端扣喺右胸袋袋蓋左方（近中線）。
zh.quote: 當選模範童軍的青少年成員可佩戴模範童軍肩帶。肩帶掛在制服恤衫右肩肩帶之下，肩帶末端扣在右胸袋袋蓋左方位置。成年成員可繼續佩戴；假若同時獲頒香港總監嘉許或高級嘉許，只可選擇佩戴其中一條。不可佩戴在西服、制服毛衣、禮服及晚禮服上。
zh.conditions: 當選模範童軍（模範童軍選舉）；之後成為成年成員仍可佩戴。

en.name: Model Scout Lanyard
en.place: Under the wearer's right shoulder strap, over the shoulder and down the front of the armhole, its end clipped at the left (inner) side of the right pocket flap.
en.quote: Youth members elected Model Scout may wear the Model Scout lanyard. It hangs under the right shoulder strap of the uniform shirt, its end clipped at the left of the right pocket flap. Adult members may continue to wear it; if they also hold the Chief Commissioner's Commendation or High Commendation, they choose one of the two to wear. Not worn on the suit, uniform jersey, dress uniform or mess dress.
en.conditions: Elected Model Scout (Scout of the Year election); may still be worn as an adult member.

modelNote.zh: 肩帶用 3D 繩示意：深綠同金黃兩色扭紋，末端有穗（P.158 相片，俗稱「雞繩」）；選單細圖係 P.158 相片。路線同嘉許笛繩一樣但喺右肩（左右反轉）：由右肩肩帶下面（膊頭嗰頭）穿出，兜過袖頂前邊、沿袖窿前面落到胸袋下面，再兜返上右胸袋袋蓋近中線嗰邊；後面一段沿袖窿後面落到腋下同前面接埋，成個圈套住右膊。童軍模型冇畫肩帶，繩直接喺膊頭上面經過。
modelNote.en: The lanyard is a 3D cord: dark green and gold twisted, with a tassel at the end (p.158 photo); the menu thumbnail is the p.158 photo. It follows the same route as the commendation lanyard but on the right shoulder (mirrored): out from under the right shoulder strap at the shoulder end, over the front of the sleeve top, down the front of the armhole to below the pocket, then up to the inner side of the right pocket flap; a back strand runs down the back of the armhole to the armpit, so the cord loops round the right shoulder. The Scout model has no shoulder straps drawn, so the cord simply passes over the shoulder.

zh.name: 隊長／副隊長／團隊長章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋、會員章下面（綱要 P.12 附圖）。
zh.quote: 童軍副隊長／隊長／團隊長佩戴相關隊長章在制服恤衫左胸袋世界童軍會員章下方位置（手冊 P.132；綱要 P.12 附圖）。
zh.conditions: 由團長委任；副隊長一條黃色橫紋（每邊）、隊長兩條、團隊長三條（手冊 P.132）。

en.name: Patrol Leader / Assistant / Troop Leader Badge
en.place: Wearer's left chest pocket, below the Membership Badge (Training Scheme p.12 figure).
en.quote: Assistant Patrol Leaders, Patrol Leaders and Troop Leaders wear the badge on the left chest pocket below the World Membership Badge (Handbook p.132; Training Scheme p.12 figure).
en.conditions: Appointed by the Scouter; one yellow bar each side for an assistant, two for a leader, three for a Troop Leader (Handbook p.132).

modelNote.zh: 圖案取自手冊 P.132；冇寫尺寸，模型闊 4.5 cm，喺胸袋底上面 0.4 cm。
modelNote.en: Artwork from Handbook p.132; no size given, the model is 4.5 cm wide, 0.4 cm above the pocket bottom.

zh.name: 服務年星
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）中央；有以前支部嘅服務年星就並排，童軍嗰枚喺最內側（近中線）（手冊 P.130；綱要 P.12 附圖）。
zh.quote: 各青少年成員在宣誓後服務滿一年者，可在制服上佩戴繡有「1」字的服務年星，兩年則可佩戴繡有「2」字的服務年星，餘此類推。童軍：綠色，數目字分別有「1」至「5」。只可佩戴在該支部獲取最高年份的一枚服務年星。
zh.conditions: 宣誓後每服務滿一年；只戴最高年份嗰枚。

en.name: Service Star
en.place: Centred on top of the wearer's left pocket flap; with earlier-section stars they sit side by side, the Scout star innermost (Handbook p.130; Training Scheme p.12 figure).
en.quote: A youth member who has served a full year after investiture wears the star with “1”, two years “2”, and so on. Scouts: green, numbers 1 to 5. Only the highest star of the section is worn.
en.conditions: One per full year of service after investiture; highest only.

modelNote.zh: 綠底白星跟手冊 P.129 樣式，數字按揀咗嘅年份；手冊冇寫尺寸，模型用 1.5 cm。
modelNote.en: Green with a white star as in the Handbook p.129 sample, numbered for the chosen year; no size given, the model uses 1.5 cm.

zh.name: 幼童軍服務年星（以前支部）
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方，同童軍服務年星並排；由內側（近中線）至外側按支部由高至低（手冊 P.130 附圖）。
zh.quote: 任何童軍在晉團後（例如由小童軍晉團為幼童軍，或由童軍晉團為深資童軍），仍可佩戴以前的服務年星，直至轉任為成年成員。各支部服務年星按次序由左至右並排佩戴在制服恤衫左胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。幼童軍：黃色，數目字分別有「1」至「4」。
zh.conditions: 喺幼童軍支部宣誓後服務滿一年先有；每個支部只戴最高年份嗰枚。

en.name: Cub Scout Service Star (earlier section)
en.place: Above the wearer's left pocket flap, beside the Scout Service Star; sections run from the inner side (nearest the centre) outwards, newest first (Handbook p.130 figure).
en.quote: After moving up (e.g. Grasshopper to Cub Scout, or Scout to Venture Scout) a member may still wear earlier service stars until becoming an adult member. Each section's star is worn side by side, in order from left to right, centred on top of the left pocket flap. Cub Scout: yellow, numbers 1 to 4.
en.conditions: One per full year of service in that section; highest of each section only.

zh.name: 小童軍服務年星（以前支部）
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方，同童軍服務年星並排；由內側（近中線）至外側按支部由高至低（手冊 P.130 附圖）。
zh.quote: 任何童軍在晉團後（例如由小童軍晉團為幼童軍，或由童軍晉團為深資童軍），仍可佩戴以前的服務年星，直至轉任為成年成員。各支部服務年星按次序由左至右並排佩戴在制服恤衫左胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。小童軍：橙色，數目字分別有「1」至「3」。
zh.conditions: 喺小童軍支部宣誓後服務滿一年先有；每個支部只戴最高年份嗰枚。小童軍服務年星要晉升幼童軍後先可以戴。

en.name: Grasshopper Service Star (earlier section)
en.place: Above the wearer's left pocket flap, beside the Scout Service Star; sections run from the inner side (nearest the centre) outwards, newest first (Handbook p.130 figure).
en.quote: After moving up (e.g. Grasshopper to Cub Scout, or Scout to Venture Scout) a member may still wear earlier service stars until becoming an adult member. Each section's star is worn side by side, in order from left to right, centred on top of the left pocket flap. Grasshopper: orange, numbers 1 to 3.
en.conditions: One per full year of service in that section; highest of each section only. Grasshopper stars may only be worn after moving up to Cub Scouts.

zh.name: 金紫荊獎章標誌
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）中央；同深資童軍先修章一齊戴時，標誌喺右（外側），先修章喺左（內側）（綱要 P.12 附圖；手冊 P.134、P.143）。
zh.quote: 曾考獲金紫荊獎章、總領袖獎章或榮譽童軍獎章的青少年成員晉升至另一支部，可在制服上佩戴相關獎章標誌，直至完成支部訓練為止。佩戴一個、兩個或三個支部最高獎章標誌，按次序由右至左佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。
zh.conditions: 幼童軍支部考獲金紫荊獎章、晉升咗童軍嘅青少年成員；可以戴到完成童軍支部訓練為止。

en.name: Golden Bauhinia Award Emblem
en.place: Centred on top of the wearer's right pocket flap; with the Venture Scout Link Badge, the emblem on the right (outer side) and the Link Badge on the left (inner side) (Training Scheme p.12 figure; Handbook pp.134, 143).
en.quote: Youth members who earned the Golden Bauhinia, Chief Scout's or Hong Kong Scout Award and moved up to another section may wear the emblem until they finish that section's training. The emblems are worn right to left, centred above the right pocket flap.
en.conditions: Youth members who earned the Golden Bauhinia Award as Cub Scouts and moved up; worn until they finish Scout Section training.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 2.6 × 2 cm 框（按 P.134 圖案比例）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses a 2.6 × 2 cm box (p.134 artwork proportions).

zh.name: 深資童軍先修章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）中央；同金紫荊獎章標誌一齊戴時喺佢左方（內側）（綱要 P.12 附圖；手冊 P.143）。
zh.quote: 符合相關資格的童軍可佩戴在制服恤衫右胸袋袋蓋上方中央位置。晉升深資童軍後，假若與金紫荊／總領袖獎章標誌一起佩戴，先修章在其左方位置（內側）。可佩戴至覆蓋成為深資童軍後一年。
zh.conditions: 年滿十四歲半嘅童軍完成綱要 P.180 嘅要求，由童軍團長簽發；晉升深資童軍後可以戴多一年。

en.name: Venture Scout Link Badge
en.place: Centred on top of the wearer's right pocket flap; to the left (inner side) of the Golden Bauhinia Award Emblem when worn with it (Training Scheme p.12 figure; Handbook p.143).
en.quote: Qualified Scouts wear it centred above the right pocket flap. After moving up to Venture Scouts, with the Golden Bauhinia / Chief Scout's Award Emblem it goes to their left (inner side). It may be worn until one year after becoming a Venture Scout.
en.conditions: Scouts aged 14½ or over who complete the Training Scheme p.180 requirements, signed off by the Scoutmaster; worn for one more year after moving up.

modelNote.zh: 圖案取自手冊 P.143；手冊冇寫尺寸，模型用 2.6 × 1.7 cm。
modelNote.en: Artwork from Handbook p.143; no size given, the model uses 2.6 × 1.7 cm.

zh.name: 和平使者章（結合世界童軍會員章）
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋中央，代替世界童軍會員章（綱要 P.12–14 附圖「會員章 或 和平使者章」）。
zh.quote: 會員章 或 和平使者章（綱要 P.12 附圖，同一位置）。青少年成員在獲取和平使者章後可佩戴於童軍制服直至晉升支部前（綱要 P.166）。
zh.conditions: 參加已喺世界童軍組織網站登記、總會核准嘅和平使者計劃活動；青少年成員可以戴到晉升支部前（綱要 P.166）。

en.name: Messengers of Peace Badge (combined with the World Membership Badge)
en.place: Centre of the wearer's left chest pocket, in place of the World Membership Badge (Training Scheme pp.12–14 figures “Membership Badge or Messengers of Peace Badge”).
en.quote: Membership Badge or Messengers of Peace Badge (Training Scheme p.12 figure, same position). Youth members who receive the badge may wear it on the uniform until they move up to the next section (Training Scheme p.166).
en.conditions: A Messengers of Peace activity registered with WOSM and approved by the Association; youth members wear it until they move up (Training Scheme p.166).

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.155 寫喺右胸袋袋蓋上方；綱要 P.12–14 附圖將佢同會員章放喺同一位置（左胸袋中央），跟較新嘅綱要。開咗就唔再另外戴世界童軍會員章。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.155 puts it above the right pocket flap; the Training Scheme pp.12–14 figures give it the Membership Badge position (centre of the left pocket), and the newer scheme is followed. When on, the separate World Membership Badge is not worn.

zh.name: 地球部落徽章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖、地域章／區章下面一行；世界童軍組織徽章系列同「積極公民」獎章系列最多合共四個（綱要 P.12–14 附圖）；唔可以戴喺專章帶上（綱要 P.15）。
zh.quote: 地球部落 – 走塑達人章、自然守護者章、日光善用者章（綱要 P.167「世界童軍組織推出的徽章」）。
zh.conditions: 完成地球部落任何一項挑戰；應同最少一個挑戰徽章一齊戴。

en.name: Earth Tribe Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, in the row below the Region/District Badges; WOSM series and Active Citizen series at most four in total (Training Scheme pp.12–14 figures); not worn on the proficiency badge sash (Training Scheme p.15).
en.quote: Earth Tribe – Plastic Tide Turners, Champions for Nature and Scouts Go Solar (Training Scheme p.167, “The World Scout Badges”).
en.conditions: Complete any Earth Tribe challenge; wear with at least one challenge badge.

modelNote.zh: 綱要冇寫尺寸；模型用直徑 3 cm，令四個章喺地域章／區章同小隊章之間放得落（綱要 P.12 附圖：四個圓章一行，喺小隊章上面）。
modelNote.en: No size given; the model uses 3 cm so that four badges fit between the Region/District Badges and the Patrol Badge (Training Scheme p.12 figure: four round badges in one row above the Patrol Badge).

zh.name: 走塑達人挑戰徽章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖、地域章／區章下面一行；世界童軍組織徽章系列同「積極公民」獎章系列最多合共四個（綱要 P.12–14 附圖）；唔可以戴喺專章帶上（綱要 P.15）。
zh.quote: 地球部落 – 走塑達人章、自然守護者章、日光善用者章（綱要 P.167「世界童軍組織推出的徽章」）。
zh.conditions: 完成走塑達人挑戰（地球部落）。

en.name: Plastic Tide Turners Challenge Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, in the row below the Region/District Badges; WOSM series and Active Citizen series at most four in total (Training Scheme pp.12–14 figures); not worn on the proficiency badge sash (Training Scheme p.15).
en.quote: Earth Tribe – Plastic Tide Turners, Champions for Nature and Scouts Go Solar (Training Scheme p.167, “The World Scout Badges”).
en.conditions: Complete the Plastic Tide Turners Challenge (Earth Tribe).

modelNote.zh: 綱要冇寫尺寸；模型用直徑 3 cm，令四個章喺地域章／區章同小隊章之間放得落（綱要 P.12 附圖：四個圓章一行，喺小隊章上面）。
modelNote.en: No size given; the model uses 3 cm so that four badges fit between the Region/District Badges and the Patrol Badge (Training Scheme p.12 figure: four round badges in one row above the Patrol Badge).

zh.name: 自然守護者挑戰徽章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖、地域章／區章下面一行；世界童軍組織徽章系列同「積極公民」獎章系列最多合共四個（綱要 P.12–14 附圖）；唔可以戴喺專章帶上（綱要 P.15）。
zh.quote: 地球部落 – 走塑達人章、自然守護者章、日光善用者章（綱要 P.167「世界童軍組織推出的徽章」）。
zh.conditions: 完成自然守護者挑戰（地球部落）。

en.name: Champions for Nature Challenge Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, in the row below the Region/District Badges; WOSM series and Active Citizen series at most four in total (Training Scheme pp.12–14 figures); not worn on the proficiency badge sash (Training Scheme p.15).
en.quote: Earth Tribe – Plastic Tide Turners, Champions for Nature and Scouts Go Solar (Training Scheme p.167, “The World Scout Badges”).
en.conditions: Complete the Champions for Nature Challenge (Earth Tribe).

modelNote.zh: 綱要冇寫尺寸；模型用直徑 3 cm，令四個章喺地域章／區章同小隊章之間放得落（綱要 P.12 附圖：四個圓章一行，喺小隊章上面）。
modelNote.en: No size given; the model uses 3 cm so that four badges fit between the Region/District Badges and the Patrol Badge (Training Scheme p.12 figure: four round badges in one row above the Patrol Badge).

zh.name: 日光善用者挑戰徽章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖、地域章／區章下面一行；世界童軍組織徽章系列同「積極公民」獎章系列最多合共四個（綱要 P.12–14 附圖）；唔可以戴喺專章帶上（綱要 P.15）。
zh.quote: 地球部落 – 走塑達人章、自然守護者章、日光善用者章（綱要 P.167「世界童軍組織推出的徽章」）。
zh.conditions: 完成日光善用者挑戰（地球部落）。

en.name: Scouts Go Solar Challenge Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, in the row below the Region/District Badges; WOSM series and Active Citizen series at most four in total (Training Scheme pp.12–14 figures); not worn on the proficiency badge sash (Training Scheme p.15).
en.quote: Earth Tribe – Plastic Tide Turners, Champions for Nature and Scouts Go Solar (Training Scheme p.167, “The World Scout Badges”).
en.conditions: Complete the Scouts Go Solar Challenge (Earth Tribe).

modelNote.zh: 綱要冇寫尺寸；模型用直徑 3 cm，令四個章喺地域章／區章同小隊章之間放得落（綱要 P.12 附圖：四個圓章一行，喺小隊章上面）。

notAllowed.zh: 呢一版示範制服頁列明嘅基本徽章（世界童軍會員章、香港章、地域章、區章、旅章、小隊章）、優異旅團章、模範童軍肩帶、隊長／副隊長／團隊長章、服務年星同全部專科徽章（v24，連專章帶）；進度性獎章等之後再加。
notAllowed.en: This version shows the basic badges on the uniform page (World Membership, Hong Kong, Region, District, Group and Patrol Badges), the Meritorious Group Badge, the Model Scout lanyard, the Patrol Leader / Assistant / Troop Leader badges and Service Stars and every proficiency badge (v24, with the sash); progress awards and others come later.

notAllowed.zh: 團隊長唔戴小隊章（手冊 P.30；綱要 P.12「小隊章（團隊長除外）」）。
notAllowed.en: The Troop Leader does not wear a Patrol Badge (Handbook p.30; Training Scheme p.12 “Patrol Badge (except Troop Leader)”).

uninvested.zh: 未宣誓嘅青少年成員（小童軍除外）可穿著全套制服（不需扣上衣領鈕扣）；世界童軍會員章、制服帽、旅巾同童軍小隊章需待宣誓後纔可佩戴。
uninvested.en: Uninvested youth members (except Grasshoppers) may wear the full uniform (top button undone); the World Membership Badge, uniform cap, neckerchief and Scout Patrol Badge are worn only after investiture.

conflicts.zh: 地域章／區章前後：手冊 P.95 文字「地域章在前，區章在後」；P.169 同綱要 P.12 附圖亦一致。模型照做。
conflicts.en: Region/District order: the Handbook p.95 text says Region in front, District behind; the p.169 and Training Scheme p.12 figures agree. The model follows this.

conflicts.zh: 小隊章同優異旅團章：小隊章底邊喺袖口縫線上方 3 cm（手冊 P.131），優異旅團章貼住縫線（0.3 cm，同幼童軍一樣）；兩章中間有 0.7 cm，同 P.169、綱要 P.12 附圖次序一致。
conflicts.en: Patrol vs Meritorious badge: the Patrol Badge sits 3 cm above the sleeve seam (Handbook p.131) and the Meritorious Group Badge just above the seam (0.3 cm, as for Cubs), leaving 0.7 cm between them — the same order as the p.169 and Training Scheme p.12 figures.

conflicts.zh: 褲／襪顏色：手冊 P.30 寫「草青色」、綱要 P.12 寫「青草色」；同一顏色，模型用手冊寫法。
conflicts.en: Shorts/socks colour: the Handbook p.30 says 草青色 and the Training Scheme p.12 says 青草色 — the same grass green; the model uses the Handbook wording.

artCredit.zh: 徽章圖案取自香港童軍總會《儀容與制服手冊》P.25、P.92–93、P.102、P.159、《童軍支部訓練綱要》P.200–202 及香港童軍總會網頁「地域及區」，版權屬香港童軍總會。海童軍帽帶取自手冊 P.102。旅章係手冊示例圖案；區章、地域章、小隊章可以揀返自己嘅。
artCredit.en: Badge artwork is from the Scout Association of Hong Kong Uniform Handbook (pp.25, 92–93, 102, 159), the Scout Section Training Scheme (pp.200–202) and the SAHK “Regions and Districts” page; copyright the Scout Association of Hong Kong. The Sea Scout cap tally is from Handbook p.102. The Group Badge is the handbook example; pick your own District and Patrol to get the right badges.

pocketL.zh: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）：服務年星；有以前支部嘅服務年星就並排喺外側（手冊 P.130；綱要 P.12 附圖）。
pocketL.en: On top of the wearer's left pocket flap: the Service Star, with earlier-section stars beside it towards the outside (Handbook p.130; Training Scheme p.12 figure).

pocketR.zh: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）：金紫荊獎章標誌喺右（外側），深資童軍先修章喺左（內側）；只戴一個就置中（綱要 P.12 附圖；手冊 P.134、P.143）。
pocketR.en: On top of the wearer's right pocket flap: the Golden Bauhinia Award Emblem on the right (outer side), the Venture Scout Link Badge on the left (inner side); a single badge is centred (Training Scheme p.12 figure; Handbook pp.134, 143).

sleeveR.zh: 穿著者右袖、地域章／區章下面一行：世界童軍組織徽章系列（地球部落）同「積極公民」獎章系列，最多合共四個，喺小隊章上面（綱要 P.12–14 附圖）。
sleeveR.en: Wearer's right sleeve, one row below the Region/District Badges: WOSM series (Earth Tribe) and Active Citizenship series, at most four in total, above the Patrol Badge (Training Scheme pp.12–14 figures).

profL.zh: 穿著者左袖下方：專科徽章（菱形）由袖口縫線上面排起，一行三個、上一行兩個，咬合排列（綱要 P.12 附圖、手冊 P.169 附圖）；模型排三行（最多 8 個），按教導組 → 服務組 → 技能組 → 興趣組由上排落。用專章帶就頭 16 個戴喺專章帶，第 17 個起先戴喺袖（綱要 P.15）。
profL.en: Lower wearer's left sleeve: the diamond proficiency badges start just above the cuff seam, three in a row with two interlocking above (Training Scheme p.12 figure; Handbook p.169 figure); the model uses three rows (at most 8), filled from the top in the order Instructor → Service → Pursuit → Interest. With the sash, the first 16 go on the sash and the 17th onwards on the sleeve (Training Scheme p.15).
